title: Cubic Repository Configuration
description: JSON schema for cubic.yaml (and the legacy .cubic.yaml) so editors can validate and autocomplete repository settings.

reviews.description: AI review behavior and optional YAML-defined custom agents.

senior_reviewers.description: GitHub usernames to learn review patterns from. Overrides dashboard selections; an empty list disables senior reviewer learning.

enabled.description: Master toggle for AI reviews on this repository.

sensitivity.description: Controls how strictly Cubic flags issues.

incremental_commits.description: If true, reviews new commits pushed to open PRs (only new issues are posted). If false, reviews only when the PR is first opened, plus cubic's own pushes while auto-fix is on.

check_drafts.description: If true, reviews draft PRs immediately when opened. If false, skips them.

architecture_diagrams.description: If true, includes AI-generated architecture diagrams in review summaries.

external_contributors_require_manual_rev.description: If true, cubic skips automatic reviews for public-repository PRs from external contributors until a trusted installation member manually triggers a review.

show_ai_feedback_buttons.description: Deprecated and ignored. Retained so existing cubic.yaml files continue to validate.

resolve_threads_when_addressed.description: Automatically resolve GitHub review threads when cubic detects the issue has been addressed in a subsequent commit.

merge_confidence_summary.description: If true, includes an AI-generated merge confidence summary on full reviews.

auto_approve_behavior.description: Controls whether auto-approval is disabled, simulated in shadow mode, or submitted live to GitHub.

auto_approve.description: Auto-approve mode: disabled, always approve clean runs, use low-risk heuristics, or use a custom prompt.

auto_approve_custom_prompt.description: Custom criteria for auto-approval. Only used when auto_approve is custom.

ultrareview.description: Master switch for ultrareviews. disabled blocks all ultrareviews (manual and automatic), manual allows only manual triggers (the default), automatic also enables the automatic triggers.

auto_ultrareview.description: Auto-trigger ultrareview mode: disabled, let cubic decide per PR using built-in high-risk criteria, or use a custom prompt.

auto_ultrareview_custom_prompt.description: Custom criteria describing which PRs warrant an ultrareview. Only used when auto_ultrareview is custom.

auto_ultrareview_file_patterns.description: File or directory globs that always trigger an ultrareview. If any changed file in a PR matches, cubic runs an ultrareview regardless of the auto_ultrareview mode.

custom_instructions.description: Free-form reviewer guidance. Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed.

custom_rules.description: List of YAML-managed custom agents enforced before UI-defined agents.

pr_descriptions.description: Configuration for AI-authored pull request descriptions.

instructions.description: Extra guidance inserted into generated summaries.

cubic_review_link.description: Include a link to review the PR in cubic (eg www.cubic.dev/pr/owner/repo/123).

skip_if_author_description.description: Skip AI description generation on new PRs when the author already wrote a substantive description. Empty or template-only descriptions still get an AI description.

issues.description: Issue and PR comment fix settings.

fix_with_cubic_buttons.description: Toggle Fix with cubic buttons inside GitHub issues.

pr_comment_fixes.description: Allow cubic to make code changes when requested from PR comment threads.

fix_commits_to_pr.description: No longer used. Fixes on a pull request commit to its branch unless you ask cubic to "open a fix PR".

auto_fix_sign_commits.description: Deprecated and ignored: cubic signs the commits it pushes whenever it can. Retained so existing cubic.yaml files continue to validate.

coding_agent_provider.description: Which coding agent applies automatic fixes. 'cubic' uses cubic's built-in agent; 'cursor_cloud_agent' dispatches a Cursor cloud agent (requires Cursor configuration).

auto_fix.description: When auto-fix runs. 'off' turns it off, 'on_demand' lets someone turn it on for each pull request, and 'on' turns it on for every pull request that matches auto_fix_rules. Needs coding_agent_provider 'cubic' and fix_with_cubic_buttons.

auto_fix_rules.description: Which pull requests auto_fix 'on' turns auto-fix on for. A whitespace-only list item, a value longer than 256 characters after trimming, or an empty only_ list makes cubic ignore all the rules and keep auto-fix on demand (or off, with auto_fix 'off'). An empty-string item invalidates the entire YAML file and falls back to UI settings, which may still have auto-fix On.

coding_agent_instructions.description: Instructions cubic's coding agent follows in this repository when it fixes issues (Fix with cubic, auto-fix, and @cubic requests). Applies only to the 'cubic' coding agent. Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; an empty string clears the value.

globList.description: List of glob patterns. Empty strings are ignored at runtime.

ignore.description: Conditional ignore filters that skip AI reviews.

head_branches.description: Source branches that should not trigger reviews.

base_branches.description: Target branches that should not trigger reviews.

pr_labels.description: Labels that disable reviews when present.

pr_titles.description: Wildcard matches applied to pull request titles.

max_changed_lines.description: Store the automatic-review threshold for reviewable added plus deleted lines. Positive integers up to 2,147,483,647 are preserved, but cubic applies an effective 50,000-line ceiling to every review. Manual triggers can bypass a lower configured threshold, but not the effective ceiling.

autoApproveRules.description: Rules that control whether auto-approval evaluation is allowed.

exclude.description: Changed files matching these globs are never eligible for auto-approval.

only_files.description: Every changed path must match at least one of these globs for the pull request to be eligible for auto-approval. Renamed files must match on both their current and previous paths.

exclude_external_contributors.description: If true, public-repository PRs from external contributors, or from authors cubic cannot verify, are reviewed but never auto-approved.

allow_open_issues.description: Open cubic findings that don't block auto-approval, by priority. none blocks on any open finding; p3, p2_and_p3, and p1_to_p3 allow that range; all allows every open finding. A finding without a recorded priority blocks unless this is all. Every other auto-approval rule still applies.

exclude_authors.description: PRs from a matching author are never auto-approved. Logins match case-insensitively and brackets are literal, so `renovate[bot]` and `*[bot]` both work.

only_authors.description: Only PRs from a matching author can be auto-approved.

exclude_head_branches.description: PRs whose source branch matches are never auto-approved.

only_head_branches.description: Only PRs whose source branch matches can be auto-approved.

exclude_base_branches.description: PRs targeting a matching base branch are never auto-approved.

only_base_branches.description: Only PRs targeting a matching base branch can be auto-approved.

exclude_labels.description: PRs carrying a matching label are never auto-approved. Labels match exactly, case-insensitively.

only_labels.description: Only PRs carrying a matching label can be auto-approved. Labels match exactly, case-insensitively.

exclude_titles.description: PRs whose title matches are never auto-approved.

only_titles.description: Only PRs whose title matches can be auto-approved.

autoFixRules.description: Rules that pick which pull requests auto_fix 'on' turns auto-fix on for. exclude_ keys skip a pull request on any match; only_ keys are an allowlist the pull request must match for that attribute. People can still turn auto-fix on or off on any pull request.

exclude_authors.description: Auto-fix doesn't turn on by itself for PRs from a matching author. Logins match case-insensitively and brackets are literal, so `renovate[bot]` and `*[bot]` both work.

only_authors.description: Auto-fix turns on by itself only for PRs from a matching author.

exclude_head_branches.description: Auto-fix doesn't turn on by itself for PRs whose source branch matches.

only_head_branches.description: Auto-fix turns on by itself only for PRs whose source branch matches.

exclude_base_branches.description: Auto-fix doesn't turn on by itself for PRs targeting a matching base branch.

only_base_branches.description: Auto-fix turns on by itself only for PRs targeting a matching base branch.

exclude_labels.description: Auto-fix doesn't turn on by itself for PRs carrying a matching label. Labels match exactly, case-insensitively.

only_labels.description: Auto-fix turns on by itself only for PRs carrying a matching label. Labels match exactly, case-insensitively.

exclude_titles.description: Auto-fix doesn't turn on by itself for PRs whose title matches.

only_titles.description: Auto-fix turns on by itself only for PRs whose title matches.

prAttributeFilterList.description: PR attribute filter values, each between 1 and 256 characters after trimming surrounding whitespace.

customRule.description: Definition of a YAML-managed custom agent.

name.description: Rule title shown in the dashboard.

file_paths.description: Ordered repo-relative instruction files. The first 10,000 characters of the description plus concatenated file text are used.

include.description: Optional include globs. Defaults to all files.

exclude.description: Optional exclude globs that override includes.

only_repositories.description: Run this agent only on matching repositories. Each value is a repository name, an owner/name, or a pattern such as web-*, where * matches any characters and ? matches one. Matching ignores case. Mainly useful in the organization config.

exclude_repositories.description: Never run this agent on matching repositories, even when only_repositories matches them. Takes the same values as only_repositories.
